exposure: Copper T 380 IUD insertion during cesarean section
Multiload Cu 375 IUD insertion during cesarean section
cohort: The study included 143 women who received either a Copper T 380 or Multiload Cu 375 IUD immediately after cesarean section for contraception.
finding: This study found no significant difference in expulsion rates or pelvic/vaginal infections between Copper T380 and Multiload Cu 375 IUDs when inserted during cesarean section, although Copper T380 initially showed higher menstrual bleeding.
mod_finding: The study confirmed that the insertion of either copper T380 or Multiload Cu IUDs during cesarean section is an effective and safe long-term contraceptive option.
